receives: fee share of a gain, from the vault
the bond or what is left of it, at settlement
backer.note: own address and key; the agent key cannot move the bond

bond.note: test token that stands in for wCOSMO on testnet; it is not wCOSMO and has no value

settlement.when: once per mandate: after valid_until (anyone may trigger it) or after the owner revokes
settlement.result: vault value now, with withdrawals counted as still there, against deposits left untouched, both at the oracle price of the settlement
settlement.gain: fee_share_bps of the gain goes from the vault to the backer, in the quote asset (in the base asset if the quote asset does not suffice)
settlement.loss: bond * min(loss / (cover_bps of the untouched value), 1) goes to the capital owner, in the bond asset

liquidity.how: standing quote inside the vault; anyone can trade against it with mandate_vault::take
liquidity.price: oracle price of the fill transaction, moved by the quoted edge in favour of the vault

venue.note: test counterparty for agent_swap, fills at oracle price minus fee

baselines: B-HOLD: value of the deposited assets, untouched, at the same oracle price
B-FAIR: every fill valued at the oracle price of its own transaction
test_flow: Takers on testnet are two bots run by the vault operator and anyone who uses the faucet. They prove the mechanism, not an income.
termination: expiry, owner revoke, owner pause, or NAV floor halt; no automatic renewal; one settlement
